boundaries: No cover design unless requested (interior only)

commercial_proposal.delivery_schedule: Day 1: files + specs lock. Day 2-3: Book 1 interior + QA. Day 4: Book 2 interior + QA. Day 5: revision buffer + handover.
commercial_proposal.delivery_scope: 2 print-ready KDP interiors (PDF) from provided Word manuscripts

execution.process: Ingest Word via pipeline tooling -> apply KDP trim/margin/typography rules -> automated QA (inspectors) -> human read-through -> deliver
execution.quality_method: inspectors.py Dual Inspection (page count, dimensions, empty pages, placeholder scan) + read-through

commercial_proposal.input: Buyer Word manuscripts + answers to 4 clarification questions
commercial_proposal.opening: I typeset print-ready KDP interiors from finished manuscripts — clean typography, correct trim and margins, QA-checked page by page. Two books, one week, fixed scope.
commercial_proposal.price_hypothesis: $60-90 fixed for both books (within buyer $30-100; reflects ~6-9h pipeline-assisted + QA work)
commercial_proposal.understanding: Manuscript is finished and proof-read; need is professional interior transformation for 2 books.
